name: Cell
description: Represents a single table cell. The Cell object is a member of the Cells collection. The Cells collection represents all the cells in the specified object.
remarks: Use Cell (row, column), where row is the row number and column is the column number, or Cells (index), where index is the index number, to return a Cell object. The following example applies shading to the second cell in the first row. The following example applies shading to the first cell in the first row. Use the Add method to add a Cell object to the Cells collection. You can also use the InsertCells method of the Selection object to insert new cells. The following example adds a cell before the first cell in myTable. The following example sets a range ( myRange ) that references the first two cells in the first table. After the range is set, the cells are combined by the Merge method. Remarks Use the Add method with the Rows or Columns collection to add a row or column of cells. Use the Information property with a Selection object to return the current row and column number. The following example changes the width of the first cell in the selection and then displays the cell's row number and column number.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the portion of a document that's contained in the specified object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Cell object.

properties.name: RowIndex
properties.description: Returns the number of the row that contains the specified cell. Read-only Long.

properties.name: ColumnIndex
properties.description: Returns the number of the table column that contains the specified cell. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of a table cell, in points. Read/write Single.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets the height of the specified table cell. .

properties.name: HeightRule
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdRowHeightRule constant that represents the rule for determining the height of the specified cells or rows. Read/write.

properties.name: VerticalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical alignment of text in one or more cells of a table. Read/write WdCellVerticalAlignment.

properties.name: Column
properties.description: Returns a Column object that represents the table column containing the specified cell. Read-only.

properties.name: Row
properties.description: Returns a Row object that represents the row containing the specified cell.

properties.name: Next
properties.description: Returns a Cell object that represents the next table cell in the Cells collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Previous
properties.description: Returns a Cell object that represents the previous table cell in the Cells collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Shading
properties.description: Returns a Shading object that refers to the shading formatting for the specified object.

properties.name: Borders
properties.description: Returns a Borders collection that represents all the borders for the specified object.

properties.name: Tables
properties.description: Returns a Tables collection that represents all the nested tables inside the specified table cell. Read-only.

properties.name: NestingLevel
properties.description: Returns the nesting level of the specified cell. Read-only Long.

properties.name: WordWrap
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word wraps text to multiple lines and lengthens the cell so that the cell width remains the same. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PreferredWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the preferred width (in points or as a percentage of the window width) for the specified cell. Read/write Single.

properties.name: FitText
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word visually reduces the size of text typed into a cell so that it fits within the column width. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: TopPadding
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space (in points) to add above the contents of a single cell or all the cells in a table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: BottomPadding
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space (in points) to add below the contents of a single cell or all the cells in a table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: LeftPadding
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space (in points) to add to the left of the contents of a single cell or all the cells in a table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: RightPadding
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space (in points) to add to the right of the contents of a single cell or all the cells in a table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: ID
properties.description: Returns or sets the identifying label for the specified object when the current document is saved as a webpage. Read/write String.

properties.name: PreferredWidthType
properties.description: Returns or sets the preferred unit of measurement to use for the width of the specified cell. Read-only WdPreferredWidthType.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a table cell or cells and optionally controls how the remaining cells are shifted.

parameters.name: ShiftCells
parameters.description: The direction in which the remaining cells are to be shifted. Can be any WdDeleteCells constant. If omitted, cells to the right of the last deleted cell are shifted left.

methods.name: Formula
methods.description: Inserts an = (Formula) field that contains the specified formula into a table cell.

parameters.name: Formula
parameters.description: The mathematical formula you want the = (Formula) field to evaluate. Spreadsheet-type references to table cells are valid. For example, "=SUM(A4:C4)" specifies the first three values in the fourth row. For more information about the = (Formula) field, see Field codes:= (Formula) field.

parameters.name: NumFormat
parameters.description: A format for the result of the = (Formula) field. For information about the types of formats you can apply, see Numeric Picture (\#) field switch.

methods.name: SetWidth
methods.signature: SetWidth(ColumnWidth As Single, RulerStyle As WdRulerStyle)
methods.description: Sets the width of columns or cells in a table.

parameters.name: ColumnWidth
parameters.description: The width of the specified column or columns, in points.

parameters.name: RulerStyle
parameters.description: Controls the way Word adjusts cell widths.

methods.name: SetHeight
methods.signature: SetHeight(RowHeight As Variant, HeightRule As WdRowHeightRule)
methods.description: Sets the height of table cells.

parameters.name: RowHeight
parameters.description: The height of the row or rows, in points.

parameters.name: HeightRule
parameters.description: The rule for determining the height of the specified cells.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges the specified table cell with another table cell. The result is a single table cell.

parameters.name: MergeTo
parameters.description: The cell to be merged with.

methods.name: Split
methods.description: Splits a single table cell into multiple cells.

parameters.name: NumRows
parameters.description: The number of rows that the cell or group of cells is to be split into.

parameters.name: NumColumns
parameters.description: The number of columns that the cell or group of cells is to be split into.

methods.name: AutoSum
methods.description: Inserts an = (Formula) field that calculates and displays the sum of the values in table cells above or to the left of the cell specified in the expression.
